text_block_list.text:
Hearing Gold Ship's boisterous laughter, I 
went to check on her, and—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer!! Hey, hey, look at that thing 
by your feet!!

"What lay at my feet was a paper airplane. 
Unfolding it to look inside—"

"Inside were a few drawn lines. And right 
in the center were the words: 'Do your 
best, Golshi'..."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
There's no doubt about it, this is totally 
a fan letter, right?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Still, it's super cool, right? If you 
fold it along the lines, it turns into a 
paper airplane that flies crazy far!!"

As expected of Gold Ship's fans, they 
understand her very well.

Deeply appreciating their thoughtful 
kindness, I reaffirmed my determination as 
a Trainer as well.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, getting pumped up? Ready to bring the 
heat? Allllright, love to see it!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Then keep that momentum going, hop on the 
giant paper airplane I'm about to make, 
and fly away, alright!?
